## v1.3

- Fresh installs start with the Flipper's built-in fonts, which read cleanly on every display; Inter and Mix stay available in Settings → Font

## v1.2

- Wi-Fi (beta): go online through a FlipperHTTP board on the GPIO header, no computer needed
- Settings → Connection switches between the desktop helper and the Wi-Fi board

## v1.1

- Font styles: choose Inter, the Flipper's built-in fonts or a mix in Settings → Font

## v1.0

- Initial release
- Subscribers, views and videos on three cards with count-up animation
- New-subscriber alert with chime, haptic tick and green LED, each switchable
- Info sheet and on-device settings: sound, vibration, LED, backlight, interval, language
- English and German user interface
- USB and Bluetooth through the Flipper Internet Bridge
